facebook.long_form:
The Kawhi Leonard saga is entering its final chapter — and the ending could come this month.

Here is where things stand on September 2nd:

The NBA found no evidence that Clippers owner Steve Ballmer funneled money to Leonard through Aspiration, one of the sponsorship vehicles under investigation. Kawhi Leonard has been personally cleared.

But the Clippers still face potential sanctions related to the broader investigation, which also examined Daktronics — a scoreboard company that installed equipment at Intuit Dome. Outside law firm Wachtell, Lipton completed their fact-finding around August 10. Now the case is with the league.

The NBA's Board of Governors is expected to hold a pivotal meeting this month. That meeting is being called the key inflection point — the moment that determines whether the trade is ratified, the sanctions are set, and Kawhi Leonard officially becomes a Toronto Raptor.

Meanwhile: Leonard and the Raptors continue to operate as though the trade goes through. Toronto's camp opens September 28 in Quebec City. Kawhi expects to be there.

And the Clippers? Per HoopsHype, they would be "fine" with Kawhi staying if the trade is ultimately voided. That is a contingency plan, not a preference. By all accounts, Leonard wants Toronto.

One Board of Governors meeting. That is all that stands between him and his new team.
facebook.image_caption: 🏀 The Kawhi Leonard saga is almost over. A September BOG meeting could send him to Toronto — or keep him in LA. Three months. One decision. #NBA #KawhiLeonard #Raptors #LAClippers

🔥 Heat superteam's first practice together
🍀 LeBron's first day as a Sixer
⚡ OKC chasing back-to-back Finals trips

facebook.long_form:
Twenty-seven days.

That is all that separates NBA fans from the start of the most anticipated training camp in recent memory. Veterans report on September 28. Camps open September 29. Preseason begins October 3. And Opening Night — October 20 — is now 48 days away.

Here are the biggest storylines heading into camp:

**The Kawhi Question.** The Board of Governors meets this month. Kawhi Leonard's team for 2026-27 gets decided before camp opens.

**Miami's Superteam.** Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bam Adebayo, and Klay Thompson will share a practice floor for the first time. Coach Erik Spoelstra has the most star-studded puzzle in his career to put together. Christmas Day vs. the Celtics is already circled.

**LeBron in Philadelphia.** LeBron James and Jaylen Brown open the season October 20 at Madison Square Garden against the Knicks. The 76ers moved from 20-1 to 10-1 in championship odds. Joel Embiid, reportedly looking healthier than he has in years, is ready. This team is real.

**Curry's Warriors.** Stephen Curry signed a 1-year, $62.6M deal — the first $60M+ single-season contract in NBA history. He is promising "a lot of health coming back" with Moses Moody and Jimmy Butler returning from injuries.

**OKC's revenge tour.** The Thunder host a WCF rematch against San Antonio on Opening Night. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Victor Wembanyama. Again. This time on a national stage.

Twenty-seven days. Start counting.

stories.title: Wembanyama Leads France to 7-1 FIBA Window — World Cup Path Clear
stories.angle: France closed the Group L qualifying window at 7-1 with Wemby as captain; two dominant performances locked up their World Cup path

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Wembanyama put the FIBA world on notice this window. 🌍

France 7-1 in Group L. His numbers:
↪️ 22 pts/9 reb vs. Slovenia (60% FG)
↪️ 18 pts/8 reb/3 blk vs. Sweden (6-of-7)

The Alien is ready for the World Cup AND the NBA season. 👾 #Spurs #FIBA

facebook.long_form:
Victor Wembanyama spent his NBA offseason doing what he has always done best — dominating.

France closed out the latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window with a 7-1 record in Group L, and Wembanyama — wearing the captain's armband for the first time — was the best player on the floor in every game that mattered.

Here is what The Alien did:

🇫🇷 **vs. Slovenia (Aug 27, Paris):** 22 points, 9 rebounds, 60% from the field. France won 92-67.

🇫🇷 **vs. Sweden (Aug 30, Stockholm):** 18 points, 8 rebounds, 3 blocks, 6-of-7 from the field. France won 84-69 in front of 14,750 fans at the Avicii Arena — a Swedish basketball all-time attendance record.

Wembanyama was named France's captain for this window. He said before the window that he "misses FIBA basketball." His performance backed up every word of that.

At 7-1 in Group L, France is well positioned to qualify for the 2027 FIBA World Cup. New head coach Frédéric Fauthoux has a clear picture of what his star can do in a leadership role.

NBA training camp opens September 29. Wembanyama and the Spurs host the WCF rematch vs. OKC on October 20. He has not stopped working all summer.
facebook.image_caption: 👾 France 7-1. Wemby as captain. 22/9 one night, 18/8/3 blocks the next. The Alien had a FIBA window for the ages. #Spurs #NBA #FIBA #Wembanyama

stories.title: Bradley Beal Signs With Clippers — Late Offseason Transactions Roundup
stories.angle: Beal joins Clippers on 2yr/$13.17M as rosters finalize; DeRozan to Denver, LaVine stays in Chicago, Williams to Golden State

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Late offseason transactions 🗒️

• Bradley Beal → Clippers (2yr/$13.17M)
• DeRozan → Nuggets (1yr/$3.88M)
• LaVine exercises $49M option (stays Chicago)
• Brandon Williams → Warriors (1yr/$2.6M)

NBA rosters almost set. 27 days to camp. #NBA

facebook.long_form:
The NBA's 2026 offseason is winding down — and it's going out with a few notable moves.

Bradley Beal has signed a 2-year, $13.17M deal with the Los Angeles Clippers, joining a team still awaiting the resolution of the Kawhi Leonard trade. Whether Kawhi ultimately arrives or stays away, the Clippers wanted veteran guard depth, and Beal — who brings playoff experience and a reliable mid-range game — fits that need on a team-friendly contract.

Elsewhere around the league:

📝 **DeMar DeRozan** agreed to a 1-year, $3.88M veteran minimum deal with the Denver Nuggets. DeRozan joins Nikola Jokic in a bid to make Denver a legitimate championship contender again. His mid-range scoring off the bench is exactly what the Nuggets needed.

📝 **Zach LaVine** exercised his $49M player option and will stay with the Chicago Bulls for 2026-27. LaVine chose security over free agency, giving Chicago continuity as they continue to build around a younger core.

📝 **Brandon Williams** signed a 1-year, $2.6M deal with the Golden State Warriors. Williams averaged 13 points and 3.9 assists for Dallas last year and gives Steph Curry quality backup depth in the backcourt.

Training camp opens in 27 days. The rosters are almost final. The season is almost here.

facebook.long_form:
Mark the date. October 20, 2026. Three games on NBC. The most historic Opening Night in a generation.

Here is your complete guide:

**3:00 PM ET — Boston Celtics at Detroit Pistons**
The afternoon opener sets the stage. The Celtics begin life without Jaylen Brown (traded to Philly). Detroit, after a strong 2025-26 season, hosts a marquee opponent on the biggest stage.

**7:00 PM ET — Philadelphia 76ers at New York Knicks (MSG)**
THE game. The Knicks raise their first championship banner since 1973 — ending a 53-year drought for the most tortured fanbase in basketball. Then LeBron James, wearing a Philadelphia Sixers uniform, takes the floor at Madison Square Garden.

LeBron + Jaylen Brown. Embiid healthy. 76ers at 10-1 championship odds. The Sixers did not come to Opening Night to watch the Knicks celebrate.

**9:30 PM ET — Oklahoma City Thunder at San Antonio Spurs**
The Western Conference Finals rematch. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Thunder visit Victor Wembanyama and the Spurs. This could be a preview of the WCF for years to come. 

And this is the first Opening Night on NBC since the 1990s. Get ready.
facebook.image_caption: 🏆 Knicks banner. LeBron at MSG. OKC vs. SA WCF rematch. October 20 is not just another night. Here is everything you need to know about the most historic Opening Night in a generation. #NBA #OpeningNight #Knicks #Sixers
